name: Jinneng Holding Shanxi Electric Power Co.,LTD.
summary: Jinneng Holding Shanxi Electric Power Co.,LTD., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of electricity and heat products in China. The company is involved in the development and sale of fuels, materials, high-tech electric power, and power supplies. It engages in production and sale of electric heating and electrolytic aluminum; power equipment inspection and maintenance protection; sale of new energy electric power heat and coal; solar power generation; production and sale of electric heating; and offers technical, financial leasing, and financial services.
